facts.subject: Escape crystal (Hardcore Worlds)
facts.value: 1 free at start; Death sells more for 10,000 coins
facts.statement: Every Hardcore Worlds character starts with one free escape crystal, and Death sells more for 10,000 coins each (also sold by Rick at the Wizards' Tower and the Mysterious Stranger in Ver Sinhaza).
facts.caveat: The value (1 free, 10,000 coins from Death) is verified. The researcher's added description 'an auto-escape safety tool relevant to risky courses' is NOT supported by what I fetched: the wiki describes the teleport/auto-AFK teleport as working out of a listed set of activities (Barbarian Assault, Chambers of Xeric, Inferno, Pest Control, Theatre of Blood, TzHaar-Ket-Rak's Challenges, Tombs of Amascut, and the Gauntlet), and when equipped it acts like a ring of life (which disables the activity teleport). It does not activate while the player is moving, and its teleport works only up to level 30 Wilderness. Do not present it as an Agility-course safety net without a threat-desk fact (see RFI). New content. | Carried over from agility-1-99-20261119 F-0015; every cited wiki revision was still current on 2026-11-22.

facts.subject: The Graveyard
facts.value: 2 lamps x 75,000 XP in Attack, Strength, Defence, Hitpoints or Prayer; 0 fixed Defence XP
facts.statement: The Graveyard is announced to give two 75,000 XP lamps for Attack, Strength, Defence, Hitpoints or Prayer, and no fixed Defence XP. Under the zerker build the lamps must never go to Defence. From 0 Defence XP, one lamp (75,000 XP) would reach Defence 46; both (150,000 XP) would reach Defence 53, above the cap of 50.
facts.caveat: UPCOMING, pre-release. The value is verified (T1 + wiki). Correction to the researcher's statement, recorded openly: the researcher wrote that 'one lamp alone would take Defence from 1 to well above the cap of 50'. That is wrong. `python3 tools/xp.py level 75000` = 46 and `level 150000` = 53 (Defence 51 needs 111,945 XP). One lamp would stay under the cap, both would break it. The build rule 'lamps never Defence' applies regardless. Never a route step. | Carried over from agility-1-99-20261119 F-0056; every cited wiki revision was still current on 2026-11-22.

facts.subject: Ferox Enclave
facts.value: PvP-safe town inside level 13-16 Wilderness; ring of dueling teleports directly into it without crossing the Wilderness; leaving through the barriers puts you in the PvP Wilderness, which Hardcore Worlds keeps
facts.statement: Ferox Enclave is a town in level 13-16 Wilderness where players cannot kill other players. A ring of dueling (GE-tradeable at 8 charges) teleports straight in, without crossing the Wilderness; the bank is a few tiles from the pools. Tele-blocked players cannot enter through the barriers. value.moving_rule: does NOT activate while moving; fires when movement stops
value.jagex_description: an escape option that can activate automatically after no input; Jagex calls it a teleport to your respawn point

facts.statement: No source says whether the escape crystal works in the Hallowed Sepulchre or the Brimhaven Agility Arena. The wiki lists the activities it teleports you out of (Barbarian Assault, Chambers of Xeric, The Inferno, Pest Control, Theatre of Blood, TzHaar-Ket-Rak's Challenges, Tombs of Amascut, plus the Gauntlet if carried on entry); Jagex describes it generally as an automatic escape and a teleport to your respawn point. It does not activate while you are moving; whether forced obstacle movement or a Sepulchre trap reset counts as moving is undocumented.

This function will apply in [[The Gauntlet]] if the crystal was in the player's inventory upon entry
